name: Kusunoki Ayano
source: Ryouji's childhood friend, she works as a waitress at the restaurant before the news that it will soon close down. Is short tempered and prone to smacking Ryouji (though he usually deserves it) SHe also hates his room, which she often cleans without his permission.
